assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and exertional dyspnea
The patient has known atherosclerotic heart disease
The patient has nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency
Atherosclerotic heart disease is coded I25.10
Nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency is coded I34.0
The symptoms are intermittent in nature
There is a need to correlate clinical events with rhythm disturbances
A cardiac event monitoring study is ordered to evaluate for potential arrhythmias
The cardiac event monitoring study is coded CPT 93271
The requested service is bundled under Reason Code CO-97
Medical necessity should be reviewed for CPT 93271 in relation to diagnosis codes I25.10 and I34.0
